sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Do not freeze: the Category A/B and ice-strengthened Category C applicability, component path, approval alternatives, evidence state, owner placement, and unconstrained qudt:numericValue are otherwise preserved. Fix the operatingIceConcentration unit IRI: qudt:UNITLESS expands to http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/UNITLESS, but the canonical recommended unit is http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS; bind a unit prefix to the QUDT vocab namespace and use that value.
